Notes: Jews of Beaune documented in the duchy of Burgundy arrests of August 1306 (expulsion); Jewish quarter in NW of town with Rue des Juifs; fewer than in Dijon and Chalon; no count
Duke Hugues V gave Jouffray Barroz property that had belonged to the Jews of Beaune including the synagogue (Sabbat / Place du Cebat); organized community with synagogue and Jewish quarter; no count
Sanse de Porrentruy 'who used to live at Beaune' was among the twelve households authorized in the duchy 1384-1385 and then lived at Auxonne; individual presence; no count
Late 14th century (year is approximate midpoint): Jews only living in Dijon Chalon and Beaune in Burgundy; Burgundy maximum was 13th century; no count; Burgundy expelled 1394
Modern Jewish community holds services alternately at members' homes monthly and in a rented place for holidays; no count; a Jewish quarter also existed historically
